# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff.config.reference` from the config models; do not edit. -->

Every key of a `jaffgen.toml`; a `jaff.toml` holds the `[network]` tables only.
Keys are optional unless their default reads *required*; *unset* means the key
has no value unless given.  See the [overview](index.md) for how the files,
the command line and Python combine.

## `[jaffgen]`

Code-generation run (`[jaffgen]`, `jaffgen.toml` only).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | string | unset | Built-in template collection. |
| `input_dir` | path | unset | Directory of template files to process. |
| `input_files` | array of path | `[]` | Individual template files. |
| `output_dir` | path | unset | Output directory; without it, `<repo_root>/generated`. |
| `network_file` | path | unset | Network file, or the name of a predefined network. |
| `network_config` | path | unset | `jaff.toml` to load instead of the one next to the network file. |
| `echo` | boolean | `true` | Echo the template directives as comments in the output. |
| `table` | array of table | `[]` | `[[jaffgen.table]]` data-table conversions, passed on unchecked. |

## `[network]`

Network (`[network]`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | unset | Human-readable network name; without it, the network file stem. |
| `strict` | boolean | `false` | Treat validation problems (conservation, sinks/sources, ...) as fatal. |
| `funcfile` | boolean or path | `true` | `.jfunc` auxiliary file: `true` looks next to the network file, `false` loads none, a path names it. |
| `expand_nuclei` | boolean | `true` | Expand `n_<element>_nuc` into the element-nucleus sum. |
| `reactions` | table | — | Settings of the reactions. See `[network.reactions]`. |
| `radiation` | table | unset | Radiation field; the table enables radiation. See `[network.radiation]`. |
| `dust` | table | unset | Dust; the table enables the dust module. See `[network.dust]`. |
| `thermodynamics` | table | — | Thermodynamics. See `[network.thermodynamics]`. |

## `[network.reactions]`

Settings of the reactions (`[network.reactions]`).

Each key applies to every reaction, unless a reaction's own table
(`reaction."<serialized>"`) sets it.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duplicate_policy` | `"preserve-first"` or `"preserve-last"` or `"error"` | `"preserve-first"` | How two rate coefficients over the same temperature range are resolved: `"preserve-first"`, `"preserve-last"` or `"error"`. |
| `t_cutoff` | `"clip"` or `"extrapolate"` | `"clip"` | Rate behaviour outside the temperature range: `"clip"` or `"extrapolate"`. |
| `photo` | table | — | Photo-reaction settings. See `[network.reactions.photo]`. |
| `reaction` | table | `{}` | Per-reaction settings keyed by serialized reaction; a key set there wins over the same key here. See `[network.reactions.reaction."<serialized>"]`. |

## `[network.reactions.photo]`

Photo-reaction settings (`[network.reactions.photo]`).

`None` means unset: the value comes from the global settings.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pi_database` | `"norad"` or `"verner"` or `"leiden"` | `"norad"` | Photoionisation cross-section database: `"norad"`, `"verner"` or `"leiden"`. |
| `override_custom_rate` | boolean | `false` | Recompute a `.jfunc` `chemRate<N>` rate from the cross sections. |
| `override_custom_cross_section` | boolean | `false` | Ignore `.jfunc` `photoCrossSection<N>` and use the database. |
| `use_proxy_photoreaction` | boolean | `true` | Look cross sections up under the proxy reaction (`CHx` → `CH`). |
| `shielding` | table | unset | Line shielding of the rate; without it, the rate is not shielded. See `[network.reactions.photo.shielding]`. |

## `[network.reactions.photo.shielding]`

Line shielding of the rate; without it, the rate is not shielded.  Written as one table, e.g. `shielding = { type = "leiden", shielded_by = ["self"] }`; its `type` selects the shielding model and its other keys.

### `type = "db1996"` — only for `H2._PHOTON__H.H`

Settings of the Draine & Bertoldi (1996) H2 self-shielding.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min_ncol` | number | `1e-50` | Lower floor on the H2 column density (cm^-2). |
| `min_vdisp` | number | `1e-50` | Lower floor on the velocity dispersion (cm/s). |

### `type = "hg2015"` — only for `H2._PHOTON__H.H`

Settings of the Hartwig et al. (2015) H2 self-shielding.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min_ncol` | number | `1e-50` | Lower floor on the H2 column density (cm^-2). |
| `min_vdisp` | number | `1e-50` | Lower floor on the velocity dispersion (cm/s). |

### `type = "leiden"` (the default)

Settings of the Leiden tabulated shielding.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shielded_by` | array of `"H2"` or `"H"` or `"C"` or `"N2"` or `"CO"` or `"self"` | required | Shielding species, `"self"` being the reaction's own reactant; their factors multiply. |
| `radiation` | string | `"isrf"` | Radiation-field subgroup of the Leiden table (case-insensitive). |

## `[network.reactions.reaction."<serialized>"]`

Same keys as `[network.reactions]` apart from `reaction`; a key not set here takes its value from `[network.reactions]`.

## `[network.radiation]`

Radiation field (`[network.radiation]`); the table enables radiation.

Only the shape of the settings is checked here; whether the band-averaged
spectrum converges is checked by the radiation field itself.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bands` | array of number or `"inf"` | required | Increasing photon-energy band edges in eV, at least two; `"inf"` is allowed as the last edge only. |
| `profile_index` | number or array of number | `0.0` | Spectral index *α* of the photon-number spectrum `n(E) ∝ E^(α-2)`: one for every band, or a list with one per band. |
| `mode` | `"nph"` or `"u"` | `"nph"` | Tracked quantity: `"nph"` (photon number density) or `"u"` (energy density). |
| `c` | number or string | `29979245800.0` | Speed of light in cm/s, or a symbol name (e.g. `"c_hat"`) for a reduced speed of light. |
| `background_field` | `"bb_4000"` or `"bb_10000"` or `"bb_20000"` or `"draine"` or `"habing"` or `"mathis"` or `"solar"` or `"tw_hydra"` | `"draine"` | Reference radiation field used to scale `chi_pe`. |
| `absorption_attenuates_flux` | boolean | `true` | Whether the `globalAbsorptionCoefficient` also attenuates the flux equations, not only the density equations. |

## `[network.dust]`

Dust (`[network.dust]`); the table enables the dust module.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rv` | number | `3.1` | Total-to-selective extinction ratio R_V selecting the tabulated dust model: `3.1`, `4.0` or `5.5`. |
| `u_reduction` | `"extinction"` or `"absorption"` or `"scattering"` or `"transport"` or `"none"` | `"absorption"` | Dust cross-section attenuating the radiation density: `"extinction"`, `"absorption"`, `"scattering"`, `"transport"` or `"none"`. |
| `f_reduction` | `"extinction"` or `"absorption"` or `"scattering"` or `"transport"` or `"none"` | `"transport"` | Dust cross-section attenuating the radiation flux (same choices). |
| `pe` | table | — | Photoelectric emission settings. See `[network.dust.pe]`. |

## `[network.dust.pe]`

Photoelectric emission of the dust (`[network.dust.pe]`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `threshold_low` | number | `6.0` | Lower edge of the photoelectric band in eV (grain work function). |
| `threshold_high` | number | `13.6` | Upper edge of the photoelectric band in eV, above `threshold_low`. |

## `[network.thermodynamics]`

Thermodynamics (`[network.thermodynamics]`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `eos` | table | — | Equation of state; its `type` selects the model and its keys. See `[network.thermodynamics.eos]`. |

## `[network.thermodynamics.eos]`

Equation of state; its `type` selects the model and its keys.

### `type = "ideal"` (the default)

Ideal-gas EOS (`type = "ideal"`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gamma` | number | `1.6666666666667` | Adiabatic index, > 1. |

### `type = "multi_gamma"`

Ideal gas with a per-species adiabatic index (`type = "multi_gamma"`).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default_gamma` | number | required | Adiabatic index of species absent from `gamma_map`, > 1. |
| `gamma_map` | table | required | Adiabatic index per species name, each > 1. |

### `type = "fermi_degenerate"`

Non-relativistic degenerate Fermi gas (`type = "fermi_degenerate"`).

No other keys.

### `type = "relativistic_fermi_degenerate"`

Relativistic degenerate Fermi gas (`type = "relativistic_fermi_degenerate"`).

No other keys.
